name: VIX Count Test
description: Minimal test to verify AggregationType.Count skips nulls from where() filtered series
source:
# Minimal test: Count on where()-filtered series should return non-null count

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# VIX for regime split
vix_src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix = vix_src.c

# Rolling correlation (just need some series to filter)
corr = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=close, y=vix)

# Where-filtered: high fear vs low fear
high_fear = where(vix >= 20, corr)
low_fear = where(vix < 20, corr)

# Summary table with Count — should show non-null counts, not 1097
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='VIX Count Test',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['All Days', 'VIX >= 20', 'VIX < 20'],
        col_headers=['Mean Corr', 'Days'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Test',
    order=0
)(corr, corr, high_fear, high_fear, low_fear, low_fear)
